tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (warm paper). Everything sits on this.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the code editor, table bodies, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sample I/O and code blocks, table headers, the active-line highlight in the editor.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, ghost buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, dividers, table rules. Not for controls (too faint).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, selects, secondary buttons) and queued test cells. 3.3:1 or better on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-sunken, surface-hover and primary-soft.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, placeholders and table headers, on bg, surface, surface-sunken, surface-hover and primary-soft (4.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Forest green. The primary button, the selected tab underline, Accepted cells, the logo square. As text use brand-text. Keep it to one primary action per view.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed fill.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill: white in light (6.5:1), ink in dark (9.8:1).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Moss wash: selected row, active nav item, Accepted badge background. text, text-muted and brand-text all read on it.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand green as text: links, the AC verdict, syntax keywords. On bg, surface, surface-sunken and primary-soft (5.6:1 light, 8:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ochre. Small editorial highlights only: a featured problem's marker, a Space emblem, the cover. Never a state and never a button; warning owns TLE. As text on bg and surface (5.3:1 light, 8.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind accent marks (a 'Featured' tag).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of brand-text; underline on hover and always inside body copy.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring with a 2px gap in the ground colour. Forest in light (5.6:1 or better on every ground), leaf in dark (8:1 or better).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors; as text on bg, surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error field background, Wrong answer badge background.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and Time limit exceeded; as text on bg, surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner and TLE badge background.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and Memory limit exceeded; as text on bg, surface and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info banner and MLE badge background.

tokens.name: verdict-ac
tokens.usage: Accepted. Same green as the brand: passing is what Grader is for.

tokens.name: verdict-ac-soft
tokens.usage: Accepted badge background.

tokens.name: verdict-ac-cell
tokens.usage: Accepted cell in the test progress bar (6.5:1 on surface light, 9.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: verdict-wa
tokens.usage: Wrong answer; text on surface or verdict-wa-soft, and the WA progress cell.

tokens.name: verdict-wa-soft
tokens.usage: Wrong answer badge background.

tokens.name: verdict-tle
tokens.usage: Time limit exceeded; text and progress cell.

tokens.name: verdict-tle-soft
tokens.usage: TLE badge background.

tokens.name: verdict-mle
tokens.usage: Memory limit exceeded; text and progress cell.

tokens.name: verdict-mle-soft
tokens.usage: MLE badge background.

tokens.name: verdict-re
tokens.usage: Runtime error; text on surface or verdict-re-soft, and the RE progress cell.

tokens.name: verdict-re-soft
tokens.usage: Runtime error badge background.

tokens.name: verdict-ce
tokens.usage: Compilation error; text and progress cell.

tokens.name: verdict-ce-soft
tokens.usage: Compilation error badge background.

tokens.name: verdict-pending
tokens.usage: Queued, Running and Skipped labels.

tokens.name: verdict-pending-soft
tokens.usage: Queued, Running and Skipped badge background.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Editor keywords (if, for, return). Bold off; colour alone carries it.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Editor string and char literals.

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Editor numeric literals and constants.

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Editor comments, italic. 4.8:1 on surface (light), 5.3:1 (dark).

tokens.name: syntax-function
tokens.usage: Editor function names and calls.

tokens.name: syntax-type
tokens.usage: Editor types and preprocessor directives (#include).

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection in the editor and prose; text stays readable on it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Given an array of N integers, find two distinct indices whose values sum to K.
styles.usage: Problem statements and long reading. Max width 72ch.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Only Space editors can see hidden tests.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Table headers, field labels in dense areas, meta labels.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Sample I/O, diffs, inline code in prose.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Verdict codes and numeric table cells (tabular figures).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between tight items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding, compact table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap inside a panel; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between statement sections; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top of reading pages, empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, verdict pills, test cells, inline code, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, cards, sample I/O blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, the editor frame.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars only.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and selects in toolbars and table rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary page actions; touch targets on mobile.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Submission and test-result table rows.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length of problem statements.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, toasts and tooltips only. Everything else is separated by border.
